title: Not All Dreams are Mallworld Dreams
content: How do you determine when you're in Mallworld? For me the landscapes are important, but beyond that there is a FEELING that this World has. I was recalling my vivid dreams last night, but I knew it wasn't Mallworld. Mallworld had a feeling to it. I can't even describe the feeling. Like... Something half remembered and familiar that you can't wait to get back to, but also foreboding.
